title: Search economy code retrieval Q1 enriched single shot and Q2 agentic DAG arm results evidence chunk 1
summary: Measured the enriched code_node embed fix (source body folded into the code_node embed surface, lib/code-extract/ingest.js symbolBodySnippet, 600-char cap) on the 13-query search-economy code-retrieval corpus. Setup: Zonoid Bench SDK isolated daemon (free port, never :8787) spawned FROM the enriched worktree (codex-code-node-embed-enrich) so it runs the enriched code; onboarded lib/+routes/ only (1174 code_nodes, lib:1110 routes:64) via the scripts/onboard-code extract->/overlay/code-nodes/bulk path. Metric per query: LOCATE -> FETCH top-6 located symbols REAL source via code_node.file[start..end] -> 12k-char bundle -> recall = |relevant ∩ identifier-tokens|/|relevant| (case-insensitive whole-token); tokens=ceil(chars/4).
